title: Hussainara Khatoon v. Home Secretary, State of Bihar

content.caseIdentity: Hussainara Khatoon v. Home Secretary, State of Bihar, (1980) 1 SCC 81
content.facts: Undertrial prisoners remained in custody for periods exceeding the possible sentence or without timely trial.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether prolonged criminal detention without a speedy trial violates Article 21.
content.ratioDecidendi: The right to a speedy trial is part of Article 21 and requires the State to avoid unjustified, prolonged undertrial detention.
content.holding: The Court directed attention to release and trial of undertrials and constitutional speed in criminal adjudication.
content.relevance: Use with BNSS s. 479 undertrial release and the trial timeline provisions.
